body:
The Beta Data Summary Browser provides the sex and disease phenotypes within cohorts from the Accelerating Medicines Partnership® (AMP®) Alzheimer's Disease (AD), Common Metabolic Diseases (CMD), Parkinson's Disease and Related Disorders (PDRD), and Rheumatoid Arthritis / Systemic Lupus Erythematosus (RA/SLE) projects for which SysBio FAIRplex has generated harmonized single-cell RNA-sequencing data. This data is represented in the Differential Gene Expression Browser, and was harmonized as described under the Data Harmonization Procedures. 

To preserve participant privacy and ensure strict compliance across all contributing data governance policies, cell frequencies containing fewer than 20 individuals are automatically suppressed and aggregated into the "Suppressed" category. This Beta version also omits the "Other" category, which combines non-target clinical diagnoses from individual studies that fall outside the primary disease cases of interest.  

Select the desired AMP program(s) to begin. Large pie charts summarize each variable within the entire selected cohort across all selected AMP programs. Smaller pie charts show the breakdown of each variable within each individual selected AMP program.
